purpose: discovery only; frozen EDHREC snapshots untouched
caveats: EDHREC inclusion = num_decks/potential_decks; usage is discovery evidence only, never an instruction. Kess's cEDH page is a small self-tagged sample (about 387 decks, not tournament-verified); the general page is dominated by casual lists. Cards and classes the owner removed or rejected in the 2026-10-14 rebuild (The One Ring, Opposition Agent, Dauthi Voidwalker, Consider, Jeska's Will, Flame of Anor, Past in Flames, Yawgmoth's Will, Mizzix's Mastery, Thousand-Year Storm, Hoarding Broodlord package and others) are inadmissible here regardless of inclusion. Repo EDHTop16 aggregates (data/grixis/candidates/tournament/kess-dissident-mage.json, retrieved 2026-10-16, 58 entries, conversion 0.1207) and stats.cedh.events (87 decklists, see the cEDH_events_staples file) are cited where they cover a card; conversion is observational, small-sample and confounded by pilot skill and meta.
